notes: Fixes two real bugs: the Marketplace panel's "Update all" could silently report everything current when it wasn't (raw.githubusercontent.com's edge cache was serving stale registry.json/.spin files no matter how the request was shaped -- now resolves and fetches from a commit-SHA-pinned URL instead, which can't go stale), and the app installer was bundling ~445MB of unrelated plugin-UI dev dependencies that also got copied into every fresh install's %APPDATA% on first launch -- installer is back to a normal size. Also ships the clipboard-write grant for the teacher dashboard's "Copy join link" button, and a fix so a new plugin dropped on the canvas doesn't keep spawning farther away forever.
